pep_line: Peptides are short chains of amino acids. Here every amino acid is a cell, so each peptide looks like itself.
pep_bpc157: A 15 amino acid piece of a protein found in stomach juice. Most of the research so far is in animals, on the gut lining, tendons and soft tissue.
pep_tb500: A short piece of thymosin beta 4, a protein the body uses to move cells into place and repair tissue. Research is mostly in animals, on recovery after injury.
pep_glp1: Copies of a gut hormone that tells the brain you are full and helps manage blood sugar. Semaglutide and tirzepatide are FDA approved for diabetes and weight.
pep_nad: Strictly a coenzyme, not a peptide: every cell uses it to turn food into energy and to repair DNA. Levels fall with age, which is why longevity research looks at it.
pep_sermorelin: A 29 amino acid copy of the start of the hormone that tells the pituitary to release growth hormone, so the body makes its own on its usual rhythm.
pep_note: A licensed physician decides what fits you, and some peptides cannot be prescribed at all. Nothing here is medical advice.
x_sermorelin_s3: Liver makes IGF-1, the loop feeds back
x_bpc157_benefits: Studied for tendons, ligaments and the gut lining.
x_bpc157_risks: Very little human research. Not FDA approved, and the FDA has raised safety questions about compounded versions. Banned in sport.
x_bpc157_dose: No established human dose: it has not been through human trials.
x_bpc157_stack: Stacking adds unknowns to unknowns. A physician adds one thing at a time.
x_tb500_benefits: Studied for recovery after injury and wound healing.
x_tb500_risks: Mostly animal evidence. Not FDA approved, and the FDA has raised safety questions about compounded versions. Banned for athletes.
x_tb500_dose: No established human dose, since there are no human trials to set one.
x_tb500_stack: Often paired with BPC-157 online, but the pair has never been studied in people.
x_glp1_benefits: FDA approved for diabetes and weight. Major weight loss in large trials; fewer heart attacks and strokes in heart disease.
x_glp1_risks: Nausea and stomach side effects are common. Rare: pancreatitis, gallbladder. Not with certain thyroid cancers in the family.
x_glp1_dose: Follows the FDA label: one shot a week, starting low and stepping up every few weeks.
x_glp1_stack: With insulin or other diabetes medicines, blood sugar can drop too low: a physician plans it.
x_nad_benefits: Studied for energy, healthy aging and metabolism.
x_nad_risks: Benefits in people are still unproven. Infusions can cause flushing, nausea and chest tightness.
x_nad_dose: Depends on the form: capsules of its building blocks, shots, or slow infusions. Slower means fewer side effects.
x_nad_stack: Little evidence for combinations: one change at a time shows what works.
x_sermorelin_benefits: Growth hormone and IGF-1 play roles in sleep, recovery and body composition.
x_sermorelin_risks: Injection site reactions, headache, flushing. A history of cancer needs a careful conversation first.
x_sermorelin_dose: Short-lived, so usually daily, often at night when growth hormone pulses. Adjusted by IGF-1 labs.
x_sermorelin_stack: Stacking with other growth hormone peptides raises the risks and needs close monitoring.
ph_line: Platform Health runs the checkout. Licensed physicians and licensed US pharmacies do the medicine.
ph_s1: Pick what to ask about · Nothing is prescribed in a cart: you choose what you want a physician to consider.
ph_s2: Answer a few health questions · At checkout, so the physician has what they need.
ph_s3: A licensed physician decides · An independent medical group makes every prescribing decision. If they say no, you are not charged for the medication.
ph_s4: A licensed US pharmacy sends it · Discreetly, to your door, in the states where a provider can care for you.
pep_dsip: A 9 amino acid peptide first found in the brain during deep sleep. It has been studied for sleep since the 1970s, with small and mixed results in people.
x_dsip_s3: Slow waves, the deep part of sleep
x_dsip_benefits: Studied for falling asleep and for deep, slow-wave sleep.
x_dsip_risks: Little human research, mixed results and no long-term safety data. Not FDA approved.
x_dsip_dose: No established human dose: there are no large trials to set one.
x_dsip_stack: Not studied with sleep medicines or alcohol. A physician adds one thing at a time.
pep_epithalon: Four amino acids, made in a lab to copy part of a pineal gland extract. In cell and animal studies it switches on telomerase, the enzyme that rebuilds the caps on chromosomes.
x_epithalon_s2: Telomerase switches on, in cell studies
x_epithalon_s3: The caps on the chromosome lengthen
x_epithalon_benefits: Studied for telomeres, the protective caps on chromosomes, and for sleep rhythm.
x_epithalon_risks: Mostly cell and animal work, with very little independent human research. Long-term effects are unknown. Not FDA approved.
x_epithalon_dose: No established human dose: it has not been through large human trials.
x_epithalon_stack: Stacking adds unknowns to unknowns. A physician adds one thing at a time.
pep_pt141: A ring of 7 amino acids, also called bremelanotide. It acts on melanocortin receptors in the brain, and as an injection it is FDA approved for low sexual desire in premenopausal women.
x_pt141_benefits: Works in the brain, not on blood flow. The FDA approved injection is for low sexual desire in premenopausal women.
x_pt141_risks: Nausea is common. Flushing, headache and a short rise in blood pressure. Not with uncontrolled high blood pressure or heart disease.
x_pt141_dose: Taken as needed before intimacy, not daily. The FDA label limits how often.
x_pt141_stack: Not well studied with erectile dysfunction medicines, and it can change how some medicines taken by mouth are absorbed.
pep_glutathione: Three amino acids, made in every cell. It is the body's main antioxidant: it hands an electron to free radicals so they stop damaging the cell.
x_glutathione_benefits: The body's own main antioxidant. Studied for oxidative stress and liver health.
x_glutathione_risks: Benefits of extra glutathione in healthy people are unproven. Injection site reactions, and rarely allergic reactions.
x_glutathione_dose: Depends on the form, a shot or a nasal spray. A physician sets it.
x_glutathione_stack: Often paired with NAD+. The pair has not been tested together in trials.
pep_mb: Strictly a dye and a medicine, not a peptide. It can carry electrons inside mitochondria, which is why it is studied for cell energy and memory.
x_mb_s1: A blue dye medicine, not a peptide
x_mb_s2: Carries electrons past a stalled step
x_mb_benefits: FDA approved for a rare blood condition. Studied in small trials for memory and cell energy.
x_mb_risks: Dangerous with many antidepressants (serotonin syndrome). Not with G6PD deficiency. Turns urine blue or green.
x_mb_dose: Low and high doses act differently in the body, so a physician sets it carefully.
x_mb_stack: Tell the physician every medicine and supplement you take, antidepressants above all.
pep_b12: A vitamin, not a peptide, built around one atom of cobalt. The body needs it to make red blood cells, DNA and the coating on nerves.
x_b12_s2: Bone marrow builds red blood cells
x_b12_benefits: Treats B12 deficiency, which causes tiredness, anemia and nerve problems. A shot skips poor absorption in the gut.
x_b12_risks: Very safe. With normal levels, extra B12 has not been shown to add energy. Rarely acne or an allergic reaction.
x_b12_dose: Set by blood levels: more often at first when you are low, then spaced out.
x_b12_stack: Commonly given with other B vitamins.
pep_lipoc: A blend, not a peptide: methionine, inositol and choline, with L-carnitine and B vitamins. These are nutrients the body uses to move and burn fat.
x_lipoc_s2: Fat is packaged and moved out
x_lipoc_s3: Carnitine carries it in to be burned
x_lipoc_benefits: Supplies nutrients the liver and mitochondria use to process fat. Often used alongside a weight plan.
x_lipoc_risks: Little evidence that the shots alone cause weight loss. Soreness where it is injected, sometimes an upset stomach.
x_lipoc_dose: On a regular schedule, alongside changes to food and movement. A physician sets it.
x_lipoc_stack: Sometimes used with GLP-1 medicines. The combination has not been well studied.

jn_intro: The Grateful Giraffes are heart-centered, spiritually grounded leaders in LA, SF, Austin, NYC, Miami and Israel. Walk into any Giraffe gathering and you already belong.
jn_h2: What you get as a Giraffe
jn_treasury: Membership is a one-time contribution on a sliding scale. Every one-time contribution goes to our community treasury, which supports our events and offerings.
jn_tiers: Each tier is named for a giraffe breed, from the Southern's rounded blotches to the Masai's jagged leaves. Every level gets the same access.
jn_why: What are you hoping to find here?
jn_heard: How did you hear about us?
jn_agree: I agree to the Grateful Giraffes community guidelines and values of spiritual connection, grounded practices, and a grateful heart.
jn_note: Our Giraffe Council reviews every application.
jn_thanks: Our Giraffe Council reviews every application. If it feels like a fit, you will hear from us before the next gathering.
